title: False Sense of Security: Why Probing-based Malicious Input Detection Fails to Generalize
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical reliability and generalization of probing-based methods for detecting malicious inputs in LLMs. While it uses datasets containing 'unethical' content as a label for maliciousness, it does not evaluate moral reasoning, specific ethical frameworks, or religious values; rather, it critiques the robustness of the detection mechanism itself.
